title: Major disaster declaration DR-4914-MT: Winter Storm
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4914-MT, "SEVERE WINTER STORM AND STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS") for MT, dated 2026-05-29, for an incident of type "Winter Storm". The incident period began on 2025-12-17 and ended on 2025-12-18. The declaration lists 1 designated area.
